what: The cross-file shard guard does not pin which naive file-slice model the fixture must defeat
scenario_or_breakage: With three sorted files and --jobs 2, a duplicate only between indices 0 and 2 is still found by round-robin file assignment (worker gets files 0 and 2), so a file-slice implementation can pass the guard while missing other cross-slice pairs such as 0-1. Issue #4480 and Makefile:48-50 describe pylint -j>1 contiguous file slices, not round-robin
suggested_fix: Specify the regression anti-pattern as contiguous index-range file blocks on the sorted path list; build the fixture so the duplicate spans the boundary (e.g. sorted indices 0 and N-1 with jobs=2, or 4 files with dup across the midpoint) and add a brief comment tying it to pylint -j slicing
